title: Keyless Open Source
features: A basic script that helps you progress.
script:
local args = {
	{
		"setCheckpoint",
		2,  -- change this value to your checkpoint + 1 (keep it default if start from checkpoint 1)
		false
	}
}

getgenv().farm = true
while getgenv().farm do
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer(unpack(args)) -- repeats script
    
    args[1][2] = args[1][2] + 1 -- add 1 each loop
    
    if args[1][2] > 110 then -- goes up to checkpoint 110
        args[1][2] = 2 
    end
    
    task.wait(5) -- for checkpoint to load
end -- Script ends, run again for it to go back to 100
